Your March 10 draft now leads with the one-year trial on routes 14 and 22, and both flagged comma splices are fixed. I marked those four comments addressed. You submit your own work, so the regrade request is still open. Resubmit the revised essay by Friday, March 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern. The March 7 draft is still the version on file.

I saved a checklist in Second Draft. The two biggest gaps are evidence for how much ridership rose in Riverton and an answer to how the city would pay for the trial. Those are good places to develop the essay from its current 374 words toward the final target of about 1,000.
